text:
jules: Quick sync idea 1 mini saved-query switcher in the route view: compact badge with model, a tiny cost/latency hint, and an optional routing hint icon. Need to align on API shape + telemetry for canary.

sam: Agree. Keep saved-query independent of router internals. Offer an optional routing_hint blob (advisory only).

maria: UX: single-line badge, click to expand details. Show 'advisory' pill if routing_hint present. Microcopy example: 'gpu variant 1 est 12ms / 0.4c'.

rishi: Platform: saved-query should include a small digest (model_family + fallback order) so fallback is deterministic. Also include quota preview fields: estimated_tokens, estimated_cost_units, uses_dedicated_capacity.

sam: API sketch (informal) includes id, scope, model_selector, routing_hint, preview_flags with cost_estimate_mode (server|client).

jules: Telemetry events: saved_query.preview_render, saved_query.apply, saved_query.routing_fallback_triggered (sampled), cost_estimate_discrepancy. Include saved_query.id and route.id for correlation.

rishi: Sampling default 1% for fallback events, ramp during canary. Server cost estimates start as heuristics then async profiling later. Mark preferred_region as advisory to avoid sticky routing.

maria: Visual tweak: show subtle 'high-cost' warning if estimated_tokens exceed server-provided bucket. Tooltip explains mitigation tips.

jules: Rollout: Phase A read-only preview (1% users), Phase B quick-apply switcher (10% canary). Gate by feature flag. rollout-bot: create flag.

rollout-bot: Created flag feature/ui/mini-switch/canary (default off).

jules: Action items: Sam 1 API PR + migration notes; Rishi 1 cost heuristic doc + advisory routing policy; Maria 1 compact/expanded mocks; Jules 1 telemetry schema + canary checklist.

sam: I1ll draft PR today with example responses and error contract when server estimate is unavailable.

rishi: I'll draft the advisory vs sticky guidance and server toggle.

maria: I'll upload two Figma mocks and paste links in the PR.

jules: Thanks all, will reconvene after PR review. :thumbsup:
